name: Geneva

sources.title: Geneva - Modify a commercial register entry
Geneva - Commercial register documentation and forms

steps.title: Review Geneva registry instructions
steps.description: Consult the current Geneva guidance for the requested corporate change.

steps.title: Prepare the modification application
steps.description: Prepare a written, dated and signed requisition de modification in French, identifying the registered information to be changed.

steps.title: Verify application signatures
steps.description: For a non-statutory SA or Sàrl change, check signature by two authorised collective signatories or one person authorised to sign individually, as specified in Geneva's guidance.

steps.title: Review supporting documents
steps.description: Identify the supporting decisions, acceptance evidence and other documents required for the selected change. Check requirements for originals or notarised certified copies.

steps.title: Verify filing and submission requirements
steps.description: Confirm the current submission procedure with the Geneva Commercial Register Office and ensure that the application is properly signed and accompanied by the required documents.

steps.title: Review board appointment and powers
steps.description: Distinguish the general meeting's election of board members from the board decision concerning signing arrangements.

warnings: Confirm whether the proposed change concerns board membership, operational management, signing authority or a combination of these.
Changes to the articles of association may require additional formalities, including notarial involvement.

steps.title: Review Sàrl management decision
steps.description: Identify the competent corporate body, the appointment or removal basis and any associated signing-authority changes.

warnings: Do not automatically apply SA board-election rules to a Sàrl.
Review the company's articles of association and the applicable management arrangements.

steps.title: Review appointment minutes
steps.description: Review the general meeting or other competent body's appointment decision, as appropriate to the registered role.

steps.title: Check acceptance of appointment
steps.description: Review the acceptance letter or whether acceptance is evidenced through signing the requisition, where permitted.

steps.title: Check identification documents
steps.description: Review a valid identity card or passport for the person to be registered.

steps.title: Review signature legalisation
steps.description: Check the legalisation requirements applicable to the newly registered person and their representative authority.

steps.title: Confirm signing authority
steps.description: Record whether the person has individual, collective or no signing authority, and check the supporting decision.

warnings: Geneva provides specific supporting-document guidance for registering a new administrator, manager or other officeholder.
Acceptance evidence and the decision supporting signing powers may depend on who signed the requisition.

steps.title: Review removal or resignation evidence
steps.description: Check the relevant corporate decision or a copy of the resignation letter sent to the company's registered office, as applicable.

steps.title: Verify cancellation of registered powers
steps.description: Confirm whether the person's registered signing authority must be removed together with their office.

steps.title: Review remaining representation
steps.description: Check whether the remaining registered officers continue to satisfy the company's legal representation requirements.

warnings: Geneva distinguishes departure of corporate officeholders from cancellation of powers held by other authorised representatives.
The required evidence may differ between removal and resignation.

steps.title: Review the signing-authority decision
steps.description: Review the appropriate corporate-body decision or determine whether the requisition-signature exception described in Geneva's guidance applies.

steps.title: Define the registered signing mode
steps.description: Specify individual or collective signing authority, or the cancellation of an existing power.

steps.title: Verify documents for new signatories
steps.description: Check identification and legalisation requirements for a person newly receiving registered representative authority.

steps.title: Check cancellation procedure
steps.description: For an existing signing authority being withdrawn, identify the supporting evidence required for that person's registered role.

warnings: Different rules may apply to a new signatory, modification of an existing signing mode and cancellation of an existing power.
Do not confuse an internal authorisation with a power of representation registered in the commercial register.
This is a preliminary workflow dataset and not a definitive filing checklist.
Verify the company's current commercial register entry and articles of association.
Geneva requires supporting documents to be properly executed and, where applicable, provided in original or notarised certified form.
Foreign legalisations may require an apostille or Swiss consular legalisation.
For entities subject to FINMA supervision, additional regulatory approval may be required.
All documents must undergo human legal review before filing.
